SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS name, p.description AS description, p.client_name AS clientName, p.status AS status, p.started_on AS startedOn, p.ended_on AS endedOn, p.contract_amount AS contractAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM step s WHERE s.project_id = p.project_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL) AS stepCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM step s WHERE s.project_id = p.project_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status = 'DONE') AS doneStepCount, p.bid_notice_id AS bidNoticeId, p.close_reason_code AS closeReasonCode, p.close_reason_note AS closeReasonNote, (SELECT pm.permission FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND pm.user_id = #{requesterUserId}) AS memberPermission, p.created_at AS createdAt,
p.version AS version, bc.business_category_id AS categoryId, bc.name AS categoryName, bc.code AS categoryCode, (bc.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS categoryDeleted FROM project p LEFT JOIN project_business_category pbc ON pbc.project_id = p.project_id
LEFT JOIN business_category bc ON bc.business_category_id = pbc.business_category_id AND bc.company_id = #{companyId} WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY bc.business_category_id ASC
